definitions.explanation: A polite word for a notice, announcement, or piece of information communicated to someone. The honorific prefix お makes it suitable for formal and everyday use.

examples.japanese: お{知|し}らせがあります。
{大切|たいせつ}なお{知|し}らせですので、よくお{読|よ}みください。
examples.english: This is an important notice, so please read it carefully.

examples.japanese: {休業|きゅうぎょう}のお{知|し}らせが{店|みせ}の{入|い}り{口|ぐち}に{貼|は}ってあった。
examples.english: A notice about the closure was posted at the entrance of the shop.

notes: Ubiquitous in daily life — seen on websites, in emails, on signs, and in apps. Common patterns include ～のお{知|し}らせ (notice about ~) and お{知|し}らせいたします (we would like to inform you). Without the お prefix, {知|し}らせ is a plain noun meaning news or information. The phrase {嬉|うれ}しいお{知|し}らせ (happy news) and {悲|かな}しいお{知|し}らせ (sad news) are set expressions for delivering good or bad news.
